name: sprintf-js
description: Self-maintained fork of sprintf-js 1.0.3. GHSA-hp3w-g68c-fv3c: precision specifiers reach toFixed/toExponential/toPrecision unvalidated, uncaught RangeError on out-of-range values (DoS via attacker-controlled format strings); no fixed upstream release exists. Patch: clamp precision to the engine-accepted 0..100 (1..100 for toPrecision). Version bumped to 1.0.4 only to mark the fork and satisfy ^1.0.x ranges.
